page.layout: One page of running text. Numbered paragraphs 3 to 6 and the chapter headings LXV and LXVI form the main column. Small marginal marks and two marginal headings ("Secessus", "Campaniae") stand in the right margin.

main_text.l: 3. Speciem amicitiæ pro vi amplexus, aut deceptæ hominum opinioni imponęs, aut umbram in corpus aliquando, ubi se mobilis affectus circumegit, commutabis.
4. Omnia ferendo, & ad omnia gratias agendo, ulteriorem indignationem declinabis.

6. Invidiæ te & infidiatrici aulæ subduces. Quod extremum remedium; & sæpe portus quieti exoptatissimus. Notum veterani, in palatio Adriani imperatoris, aulici monumentum: Hic jacet Similis, cujus quidem ætas multorum annorum fuit, caterum septem tantum annos vixit. Nimirum septennium illud, quod extra aulam extrema in senectute fui potestatis degit, vitæ tantum adscripsit. Hic quidem receffus moderato sub principe folicitudinum effugium fuerit. at sub tyrannis crudelitatis famam non erubescentibus, & lux exitio, & tenebræ infragilis futuræ munimenti.
LXV. Nec imperantibus aulæ semper stre-pitus perplacet.

Quem tanto ambitu quæsiverunt principatum, solitudine libenter commutant. Tiberius tædio curarum, & fallaci splendoris vultu, defatigatus, quasi firmanda valetudini, in Campaniam concessit: longam & continuam absentiam paulatim meditans. quo discessu diuturnis Capreārum latebris prælusit. nam quam annectit Tacitus conjecturam, ut amoto patre, Drusus munia consulatus solus impleret, infirmior censetur.

Sontem quidem damnare, quam alienam injuriam condonare, magis officio judicis convenit. At ubi, satisfactione intervenientè, judex temperandis animis idonea differit, mitigatio sententiam præcedit. Lucius Sulla ætate junior seniori, & prætura functo, Domitio

page.notes: Marginal marks at the right beside paragraphs 3, 4, 5 and 6 are faint and read as section signs; the readings given are doubtful. The page number "III" at top right is only a probable reading. The signature at the foot is uncertain. The word "imponęs" and the word "fui" in paragraph 6 are doubtful. Heading LXV has a printed line-break hyphen ("stre-pitus") that is kept as printed. The paragraph ending "Domitio" runs on to the next page.
